note: Canonical evidence file for 2025. Government and regulatory events are recorded descriptively and neutrally from official sources.

events.title: Bybit loses roughly $1.5 billion in record-scale hack
events.summary: Bybit reported that attackers compromised a signing flow involving one of its Ethereum cold wallets, resulting in losses approaching $1.5 billion.
events.significance: The theft became the largest publicly reported crypto heist to that date and exposed how supply-chain or signing-interface compromise could defeat otherwise sophisticated cold-wallet controls.

events.title: FBI attributes Bybit theft to North Korea
events.summary: The FBI publicly attributed the approximately $1.5 billion Bybit theft to North Korea and identified the activity as TraderTraitor.
events.significance: The attribution made the record-scale exchange hack part of the much larger history of state-linked cryptocurrency theft and laundering.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

events.title: United States establishes a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
events.summary: A US executive order established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve to be capitalized initially with finally forfeited government BTC and directed that BTC deposited into the reserve not be sold, subject to the order's terms and applicable law.
events.significance: The policy marked a major reversal from earlier eras when seized US government Bitcoin was routinely auctioned, turning forfeited BTC into a designated reserve asset.

sources.title: White House — Establishment of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve

events.title: United States establishes a separate Digital Asset Stockpile
events.summary: The same executive order created a United States Digital Asset Stockpile for finally forfeited non-Bitcoin digital assets held by the Treasury.
events.significance: The policy formally separated the federal government's treatment of Bitcoin reserve holdings from other forfeited digital assets.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile order

events.title: Ethereum Pectra activates
events.summary: Ethereum activated Prague-Electra at epoch 364,032. The upgrade included EIP-7702 account delegation, validator improvements and changes supporting additional L2 scaling.
events.significance: Pectra was one of Ethereum's broadest protocol upgrades, advancing wallet programmability and changing validator balance/operations after the Merge era.

events.title: Circle begins trading on the New York Stock Exchange
events.summary: Circle priced an upsized IPO at $31 per share on 4 June, with CRCL shares expected to begin NYSE trading on 5 June 2025.
events.significance: The USDC issuer becoming a public company marked another step in the integration of stablecoin infrastructure with traditional public capital markets.

sources.title: Circle — Pricing of Upsized Initial Public Offering

events.title: GENIUS Act creates US federal payment-stablecoin framework
events.summary: The GENIUS Act was signed into US law on 18 July 2025, establishing a federal statutory framework for payment stablecoins.
events.significance: It was a major US legislative milestone for stablecoins, shifting the sector from primarily agency-by-agency treatment toward explicit federal legislation.

sources.title: White House — S.1582 signed into law

events.title: SEC permits in-kind creations and redemptions for crypto ETPs
events.summary: The SEC approved orders allowing authorized participants to create and redeem crypto-asset ETP shares in kind, rather than limiting spot Bitcoin and Ether ETPs to cash-only creation and redemption.
events.significance: The change brought crypto ETP mechanics closer to conventional commodity ETP structures and reduced a major operational difference created at the 2024 launches.

sources.title: SEC — In-Kind Creations and Redemptions for Crypto ETPs

events.title: Ethereum Fusaka activates PeerDAS
events.summary: Ethereum activated Fulu-Osaka (Fusaka) at epoch 411,392. Its headline feature, PeerDAS, changed how nodes sample blob data and enabled major increases in data-availability capacity.
events.significance: Fusaka extended Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling strategy beyond Dencun by making substantially higher blob throughput practical without requiring every node to download every blob.
